question: Which of the following is the international partner in the implementation of ‘PM Grameen Digital Saksharta Abhiyan’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**UNESCO**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Grameen Digital Saksharta Abhiyan (PMGDISHA)** is an initiative aimed at promoting digital literacy in rural India.
 
• The scheme was launched by the Government of India to bridge the digital divide and empower rural citizens with critical digital skills.
 
• **UNESCO** (United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization) is the international partner for the implementation of this initiative.
 
• UNESCO supports the program by providing technical assistance, resource material, and promoting best practices globally.
 
• PMGDISHA aims to train approximately 60 million rural citizens, focusing on marginalized communities and women.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Digital Literacy:**

 
 
• Digital literacy refers to the ability to use information and communication technologies to find, evaluate, create, and communicate information.
 
• It encompasses a range of skills including basic computer skills, internet navigation, and understanding of digital security.
 
 
 
• **UNESCO's Role:**
 
 
• UNESCO works towards promoting education, science, culture, and communication to foster peace and security.
 
• In the context of PMGDISHA, UNESCO provides educational resources and expertise to enhance digital literacy programs.
 
 
 
• **Implementation Strategy:**
 
 
• PMGDISHA is implemented through various training centers established in rural areas across India.
 
• These centers are equipped with necessary infrastructure and trained personnel to provide hands-on training.
 
 
 
• **Target Audience:**
 
 
• The program primarily targets rural populations, including marginalized sections, school dropouts, and women.
 
• The goal is to ensure that at least one person per household is digitally literate.
 
 
 
• **Outcome and Impact:**
 
 
• Improved digital literacy leads to better access to information, government services, and economic opportunities.
 
• The program aims to contribute to the overall socio-economic development of rural areas.
